Commentary.Commentary: 184 is what World XI need to win the series. The pitch is showing signs of slowing down and it will be extremely difficult for them to chase this total. Can we expect the unexpected? Stay tuned...

A poor start, then a brief comeback only to be followed by a horrendous finish. This was the story of World XI's bowling attack tonight. No one impressed, apart from Darren Sammy, who somehow managed to get away with an economy of just 6 in the blitzkrieg.

In the 16th over, Pakistan were 127/1. But Morne Morkel's over after that was the momentum-changer, which went for 15 runs. Then Shehzad started to tee off and could have got to a century had Azam sacrificed his wicket. The latter had another good innings, finishing on 48, adding to his tally of wonderful scores.

It was a good batting display from Pakistan this time. The openers started well, till a freakish run out made them apart and then, it was the Shehzad-Azam show. The duo added 102 for the second wicket, in just 57 balls which kept World XI at bay. There was a brief period in the middle when the tourists seemed to be making a comeback but Azam's drop on 22 spoilt that.
Not a bad finish by the home side which was looking a bit behind during the middle overs. 66 runs came in the last 5, for the loss of 3 wickets. Once again, World XI have struggled at the death.
And it stays a good last over! This ball is punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a run. 8 runs from this over apart from the two wickets! PAKISTAN END ON 183/4!
Skipper SARFRAZ AHMED walks in next.

OUT! Gone! Another one in the over! Perera lands it on a length around off, Wasim looks to go over covers a la Azam. Ends up spooning an easy catch to a backtracking Faf du Plessis, who makes no mistake. Imad goes without troubling the scorers. This is turning out to be a good over in the context of the game.
Full ball around middle and leg, driven back to the bowler.
Bowls it outside off, Malik slaps it through point for a run.
SIX! Huge, nonchalant, maximum! Perera bowls a low full toss around leg, Malik just helps it over deep square leg for a biggie! That looked effortless.

OUT! What a start to the last over! Azam misses out on a fifty! Perera bowls a length ball outside off, Babar looks to go over covers. He gets the elevation but fails to get the distance. Faf du Plessis backtracks from covers and takes it safely to end the batsman's stay at the crease. That's the end of a well played knock from Azam. Perera strikes!
THISARA PERERA to bowl the last over.
Short ball around off, pulled away in front of square on the leg side for a brace.
SIX! That's out of here! Morkel bowls it full around middle, Malik just lofts it over long off for a biggie! That looks so easy to the eye!
Full ball around leg, Malik looks to hit but misses.
Bowled outside off, Azam drives it through covers. The fielder puts in a dive but is unable to prevent a run.
Length ball around off, punched to long on for a run. He gets off the mark.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Azam works it through square leg for a run.
This ball is worked away to fine leg for a run. An enterprising over comes to an end! 22 runs and a run out from the same.
SHOAIB MALIK walks in at the fall of the second wicket.

OUT! Run out! What a way to get dismissed! Cutting bowls it down the leg side, Azam looks to flick but misses. Ahmed from the other end comes down searching for a run. Bailey sees this and throws it to the bowler who hits the stumps at the bowler's end to catch the batsmen well short. Should Azam have sacrificed his wicket? Perhaps. The 102-run partnership ends and so does the 89-run knock of Shehzad. A wide signalled.
Bowls it around middle, a run taken to long on.

SIX! Another biggie! Three-in-three! The tall Cutting bowls it full outside off, Shehzad goes down low and paddles it over fine leg for another biggie! This is great batting and a treat to watch! The 100-run stand between these two is up! What a partnership this has been.
SIX! Humongous! This is some good hitting on display from Shehzad. Cutting lands it on a length around middle, Ahmed heaves it over wide long on for a huge hit. What a shot that.
SIX! Monstrous! Cutting bowls it full around middle and leg, Shehzad heaves this away with all his might. The ball travels over mid-wicket for a maximum!
Length ball around off, pulled away through square leg for a run.
BEN CUTTING is brought back to stem the run flow.
Short ball around off and middle, pulled away through square leg. A fumble from Perera in the deep allows them a couple. 15 runs off that over!
Very full ball outside off, Ahmed misses the ball completely as he looks to drive it through the off side.

FOUR! The third in the over! And the best of the lot! Morkel bowls it full outside off, Shehzad gets across and paddles it over short fine leg for another boundary. This is getting worse for the Protea giant now!
FOUR! EDGY BUT EFFECTIVE! Morkel bowls it around middle and leg, Shehzad looks to belt it away but only manages to get an inside edge. The ball races past the leg stump and goes quickly to the fence.
Length ball outside off, guided towards third man for a run.
FOUR! Again a boundary to welcome Morkel! Length ball outside off, Azam slams it over wide mid off and the ball races away to the fence in no time.
MORNE MORKEL is back into the attack. Would be interesting to see how he bowls at the death.
Bowled on the pads, flicked to fine leg for a run.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Shehzad slogs it away towards deep mid-wicket for a run. He's playing these shots wildly which shouldn't be the case.
This ball is played back towards the bowler.

NOT OUT! Perera bowls it in line of the stumps, Shehzad slogs it wildly in front of square on the leg side. They take a run and go for the second. Miller hurls a throw to the keeper who whips the bails and ask the question. The umpire refers it upstairs. Replays show that Ahmed's well in. He gets a couple of runs.
Howzzat? The third umpire is referred to for a run out appeal against Shehzad. Looks to be safely in.
This ball around off is driven through covers for a run.
WIDE! Slower ball down the leg side, Azam goes down on a knee but lets it go. Bailey does well to stop that. The first extra in the match.
FOUR! And Azam continues to look awesome! Perera bowls a length ball outside off, Babar stays back and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Loops it outside off, driven to deep cover fielder for a run.

FOUR! Aaah! The use of feet against spin is a joy to watch! Tahir lands it around off and middle, Azam charges down and just smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. The long on fielder couldn't get there to prevent the runs.
Floats it outside off, Ahmed pushes it through covers for one run.
Shortish ball around off, pulled through square leg for a run. 50-run stand off just 37 deliveries between these two. They should look to carry on.
Tosses this around off and middle, Azam charges down and plays it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Floats it around middle, Ahmed drives it towards long on for a single.
TAHIR back on. He needs to strike, which is what he does often.
A very full ball around off, Shehzad digs it out towards covers. They cross over for a run.
This ball outside off is played through covers for a run.
Full ball outside off, Shehzad moves across and paddles it towards short fine leg where Tahir stops it and throws it to the bowler. One run taken easily though.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Babar charges down and plays it to long on for a run.
This ball is played through mid-wicket for a run.

DROPPED! When in Rome, do as the Romans do, exclaims my colleague! Perera bowls it on a length around middle and leg, Azam swivels and pulls it towards fine leg. Tahir moves to his right, gets his hands to it yet spills the chance. Babar is not the right man to give a life to, considering his current form. Unlucky Thisara!
THISARA PERERA is back on for another spell.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Babar collects a single towards deep mid-wicket.
This ball is clipped through mid-wicket for a single. 100 up for Pakistan!
Slow full ball around leg, Azam drives it to long on for a run.
Sammy bowls it full in line of the stumps, Ahmed backs away and plays it towards point for a run.
This is bowled around middle and leg, Azam flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
7th T20I FIFTY FOR SHEHZAD! A low full toss around leg is worked to long on for a run to get to his milestone. He's played well today and Pakistan would want him to bat as deep as possible.
Short ball in line of the stumps, pulled through square leg for a single.
This ball is flicked away towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! STREAKY YET EFFECTIVE! Badree fires it in around off, Azam looks to cut but gets an outside edge past short third man for a boundary.
A tad shorter around middle, punched to long on for a run.
Floats it around middle, Shahzad charges down and plays it towards wide long on. Perera runs there from long on, puts in a dive and saves a couple of runs for his side.
Bowls it flatter around middle and leg, Azam flicks it through square leg for a run.
SAMUEL BADREE back on.
Another ball is knocked to long on for a run.
This ball is driven through mid on for a run.
Slower full ball around middle and leg, driven to long on.

FOUR! Glorious! Sammy bowls it on a length around middle, Azam stands tall and flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary. The ball landed just in front of the ropes there. He's really looking in good touch.
Short ball around off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Azam collects a single to long on.
This ball is played to long on for a run.
Floats it outside off, Azam drives it through covers for a brace.
This ball is guided towards third man for a run.
FOUR! What a shot! Tahir floats it around off, Shehzad smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. He picked that one early.
Floats it in line of the stumps, Shehzad charges down and plays it towards mid-wicket for a brace.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Shehzad gets an inside edge to the leg side.

NOT OUT! Sammy bowls it around middle and off, Azam shuffles across and works it through mid-wicket and sets off for a run. He wants a second and Shehzad responds, the fielder from mid-wicket gets a direct hit at the bowler's end. The umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that Ahmed is well in. The batsmen get two.
There is a direct hit at the bowler's end. The third umpire is referred to for a run out appeal against Shehzad. Seems to be in.
Another ball is knocked to long on for a run.
Lands it around middle, Azam plays it aerially towards long for a run to get off the mark.
Bowls it very full around middle, Ahmed plays a helicopter shot all along the ground towards long on for a run.
BABAR AZAM is the next man in. He has looked in good touch in this series so far.

OUT! A run out breaks this flourishing stand! Well, well! Sammy bowls it full around off, Shehzad drives it straight back. Darren manages to gets some hand on that as the ball goes to hit the stumps at the bowler's end. Zaman was backing up and that has cost him his wicket. These two were really looking good and this is an unfortunate end to the stand.
Sammy bowls it a tad short around off, Shehzad swivels and plays it through square leg. Morkel in the deep funbles a tad and allows an easy two.
This was a googly around off and middle, he works it away through mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball around off, a hint of turn there. Shehzad goes back and works it away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Zaman backs away, Tahir follows him and lands it full outside leg. Fakhar adjusts and plays it through covers for a run.
Lands it around middle, Ahmed works it to long on for a run.
This is bowled in line of the stumps, Shehzad defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowls it flatter around off, Zaman glides it towards third man for a run.
IMRAN TAHIR to have a bowl. Would be interesting to see if he manages to break this stand.
Bowls it around off, Shehzad plays it off the back foot towards covers.
Bailey comes up to the stumps.
This delivery is played towards point.
Bowls it on a length around off, he plays it back to the bowler.
This ball is played through mid-wicket for a run.
Full ball outside off, Zaman looks to drive but misses. The ball passes close to the edge of the bat.
Short ball in line of the stumps, Shehzad swivels and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a run.
DARREN SAMMY is brought in to bowl.
This delivery is worked off his pads for a run.
A yorker around middle and off with a slingy action, Zaman digs it out. The ball goes to the off side. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. They get a run.

SIX! UP AND OVER! Perera bowls it short outside off, Zaman stays back and cuts it over point for a biggie. He was struggling a while back but this ball might help his confidence raise up. 50 UP FOR PAKISTAN! Their first opening half century stand this series!
Good fielding effort there! Bowls it around off, Shehzad smashes it towards covers, where the fielder makes a diving stop but fails to prevent a run.
Bowls it outside off, Ahmed plays it towards covers.
FOUR! Not the greatest of deliveries to start with by the top performer! Perera bowls it on the pads, Shehzad helps it away through fine leg for a boundary.
THISARA PERERA to bowl the last over of the Powerplay. He had a good previous match.
Bowls it around middle and leg, Shehzad gets it over mid-wicket as he looks to pull. The ball lands in no man's land and the batter gets a run.
This ball is worked away to the leg side for a run.

Slower short ball around leg, following the batsman as Zaman was backing away. He manages to get bat to that as he pulls it through square leg for a brace. He was desperate to get a run as this delivery was preceded by three dots.
Short ball around middle, Zaman pulls it towards short fine leg. The ball was in the air for a while there.
Length ball around off, Fakhar smashes that straight to the fielder at mid on.
Begins with a length ball around off, Zaman defends it back towards the bowler.
BEN CUTTING is brought into the attack. Didn't really bowl economically in the last match and he would look to improve on that.

A run out chance, missed! Length ball around off, Shehzad looks to push it to the left of the bowler and tries to sneak a run. However, he changes his mind at the last moment. Morkel didn't realise that Zaman was halfway down the track and so didn't rush to inflict a run out.
Bowls it outside off, Zaman collects a single after playing it towards point.
Another ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Lands it in line of the stumps, Fakhar plays that within the crease.
Bowls it on the pads, Shehzad works it in front of square on the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Stunning Shehzad collects another boundary! Morkel bowls it on a length outside off, Ahmed stands tall and slaps it through cover-point and the ball just races away to the fence.
Flatter ball around middle and leg, he works it away to the leg side for a single.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, worked away towards mid on for a run.
FOUR! Glorious shot that! Badree lands it around off, Zaman charges down and goes inside out over covers for a boundary.
Lands it outside off, Zaman misses the cut.

Huge shout for LBW, turned down! Badree bowls it flatter around leg, Zaman gets down to sweep, misses and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Replays show that the ball did pitch in line and also hit him in line of the stumps. Lucky to be still out there is Fakhar!
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Zaman blocks it from the crease.
Bowls it on the pads, Zaman gets it off the inside edge to the leg side for a run.
The slip goes out now.

Almost gets him! Morkel comes round the wicket and bowls it on a length around off. Zaman looks to push it to the off side but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls between his pads. It landed next to the stumps. Could have easily played it on to the stumps.
Bowls it around off, Zaman drives it to mid off.
Length ball in line of the stumps, worked away to the leg side for a run.
FOUR! And another one, even more gracious! Morkel lands it around middle and leg again, Shehzad is just too happy to help himself to another boundary. This is wonderful batting by the opener.

FOUR! Shehzad greets Morkel with a boundary! Morne runs in and bowls a full ball around middle and leg, the batsman stands tall and flicks it wide of the mid on fielder and the ball races away to the fence. Good looking shot that, as the deep mid-wicket fielder couldn't get to it.
MORNE MORKEL will share the new ball from the other end.

Lovely shot, but just gets him a couple. Badree bowls a googly around middle, Zaman charges down and belts it over the bowler's head. The ball fails to reach the fence as du Plessis cuts it down and keeps it down to two.

FOUR! Now Zaman gets into the act! Badree lands this around middle and leg, Fakhar just aerially smashes it through mid-wicket for a boundary. The fielder at deep mid-wicket didn't stand a chance of cutting that off.
Fires it around middle and leg, Ahmed works it through square leg for a single.

FOUR! That's the first of the night! Badree lands it a tad short outside off, Shehzad stays deep and cuts it past point for a boundary. He watched that till the very end. What a way to get off the mark!
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Shehzad defends it from within the crease.
Starts off with a ball on middle and leg, Zaman drives it to long on for a single to get going.

The players and the umpires make their way out to the middle. Everybody is set for play to get underway. FAKHAR ZAMAN and AHMED SHEHZAD will open the batting for the hosts. SAMUEL BADREE to start with the new ball. Let's roll...

TEAM CHANGES - For World XI, George Bailey and Darren Sammy come in for Tim Paine and Paul Collingwood. Interesting choice as Bailey would be keeping wickets today. The lack of wicketkeeping options has made him don the gloves. For Pakistan, Hasan Ali is fit and replaces Sohail Khan.

Pakistan captain, SARFRAZ AHMED says that he will now look to put a good total on board. Admits that the execution with the ball was not correct in the previous game and they will look to correct those mistakes tonight. Also says that Hasan Ali is back, so that helps. On the target, he says that they will first assess the conditions in the first 10 overs and then see how to go from there. Has a lot of praise for Babar Azam and hopes he maintains his consistency. Thanks the crowd which seems to be filling in by the minute and the police for maintaining high security.

World XI skipper, FAF DU PLESSIS, says that it looks like a good wicket and their batting is their strength. Adds that they have power in their arsenal as they are fortunate to have a few power hitters in the side. If they can keep the required run rate under 12/13 towards the end, they could do well he reckons. He ends saying that they would try and take wickets upfront even tonight.
TOSS - World XI win the toss and choose to bowl.

PITCH REPORT - Pommie Mbangwa says that these are good conditions. Adds that the surface was the driest in the opening game. He reckons that this one's dry but looks like it will be good for batting and wouldn't change much under lights. Opines that batting first is the way to go.

Grab your bowl full of wafers and take the best place on the couch in front of the television! Hello and welcome to our coverage of the last T20I in this Independence Cup from the Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore. Both the sides have all to play for, as the series stands at 1-1. The see-saw tilted in the hosts' favour in the first game before the visitors sealed a stunning win in the second. The teams will leave nothing to chance as they vie to get their hands on the silverware. This game promises to be a belter. Will the home side be able to please their fans and manage to win the series on its home soil? Stay with us as we bring you the toss in a while.
